mapper.sql: id, name, parent_id, path, perms, type, sort_order, icon, component, is_disabled, is_external, is_keepalive, is_visible
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.name, m.parent_id, m.path, m.perms, m.type, m.sort_order, m.icon, m.component, m.is_disabled, m.is_external, m.is_keepalive, m.is_visible FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.id

SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.name, m.parent_id, m.path, m.perms, m.type, m.sort_order, m.icon, m.component, m.is_disabled, m.is_external, m.is_keepalive, m.is_visible FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.id

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.type = 'button' AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms <> ''
